articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过区分全球效应与非洲内部移民的效应，考察了移民对劳动生产率的影响。理论上，由于非洲内部贸易水平较低以及由此导致的商品和要素价格差异，非洲内部移民预期会产生相对较大的影响。实证上，我基于一个包含187个国家（其中包括53个非洲国家）的面板数据，时间跨度为1990-2019年，并采用基于重力的工具变量方法来处理内生性问题。结果表明，非洲内部移民对非洲劳动生产率具有正向、显著且稳健的影响。这一影响大于全球样本中移民的效应，并且主要通过全要素生产率和资本效率的提升来实现。虽然移民在全球范围内倾向于降低资本生产率，但非洲内部移民在非洲却提升了资本生产率。此外，服务业部门从移民的积极效应中获益更多。

articles.title_en: Unraveling financial exclusion during the COVID-19 pandemic: A gender perspective in Latin American countries
articles.title_cn: 新冠疫情19期间金融排斥的解析：拉丁美洲国家的性别视角
articles.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has affected mainly the most vulnerable population in developing countries. This research focuses on financial inclusion, with an emphasis on digital financing among men and women in Latin American countries. The analysis combines a qualitative and quantitative perspective. We first perform a comprehensive literature review of financial inclusion in developing countries, with a focus on gender gap, pre- and post-COVID. An extensive sample of Latin American countries is then studied in detail through the World Bank Global Findex Questionnaire. A series of questions is identified in relation to financial inclusion, such as financial and mobile account ownership and their use for bill payments, or debit and credit card ownership, and the differences in terms of gender are analyzed statistically. This analysis is complemented by an econometric modelization to identify the significance and strength of the variables that determine financial inclusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 新冠疫情19大流行主要影响了发展中国家最脆弱的群体。本研究聚焦于金融包容性，重点关注拉丁美洲国家男性和女性在数字金融方面的差异。分析结合了定性和定量视角。我们首先对发展中国家的金融包容性进行了全面的文献综述，重点关注疫情前后的性别差距。随后，通过世界银行全球金融指数问卷，对拉丁美洲国家的大量样本进行了详细研究。识别出一系列与金融包容性相关的问题，如金融账户和移动账户的所有权及其在账单支付中的使用，或借记卡和信用卡的所有权，并从统计上分析了性别差异。这一分析通过计量经济学模型化加以补充，以确定决定金融包容性的变量的显著性和强度。

articles.title_en: Global Distributions of Capital and Labor Incomes
articles.title_cn: 资本与劳动收入的全球分布
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the global distributions of capital and labor incomes among individuals in 2000 and 2016. By constructing a novel database covering approximately 80% of the global output and 60% of the world population, two major findings stand out. First, the world underwent an important process of capitalization. The share of world individuals with positive capital income rose from 20% to 32%. Second, the global middle class benefited the most, in relative terms, from such a capitalization process, with China being the main driver of this global trend. The findings of this paper are robust to changes in the income definition, top-income and functional income distribution adjustments. The global composition of capital and labor incomes is more equal today than it was twenty years ago.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2000年和2016年个体间资本与劳动收入的全球分布。通过构建一个覆盖全球约80%产出和60%人口的新数据库，得出两个主要发现。首先，世界经历了一个重要的资本化过程。拥有正资本收入的全球个体比例从20%上升至32%。其次，全球中产阶级在相对意义上从这一资本化过程中获益最多，其中中国是这一全球趋势的主要驱动力。本文的发现对于收入定义、高收入及功能性收入分配的调整具有稳健性。如今，全球资本与劳动收入的构成比二十年前更加平等。

articles.title_en: Urbanising the Villages: Three modes of village incorporation and the implications for structural transition in India’s “Chinese-style” special economic zones (SEZs)
articles.title_cn: 村庄城市化：三种村庄并入模式及其对印度“中国式”经济特区结构转型的影响
articles.abstract_en: This article examines outcomes of three different modes of in-situ urbanisation in the context of large “Chinese-style” Special Economic Zone (SEZ) development in rural India, arguing that mode of village incorporation has an important impact on development outcomes for local populations. It compares three Indian cases with the early stages of the SEZ “model” in China’s Shenzhen, where urban villages emerged, a thriving rentier economy grew, and structural transition was combined with distinctive infrastructural and governance outcomes. Although much work has examined macro-level economic contributions of India’s SEZs, little attention has been paid to implications for local areas beyond initial protests over dispossession, and none has focused on impacts for those whose rural settlements are enveloped by the new industrial area. Whether India’s new urban villages experience similar structural transformation to their Chinese counterparts is therefore unknown.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在印度农村地区大规模“中国式”经济特区（SEZ）开发背景下，三种不同的就地城市化模式的结果，认为村庄并入模式对当地人口的发展结果具有重要影响。文章将三个印度案例与中国深圳经济特区“模式”的早期阶段进行比较，在深圳，城中村出现，繁荣的食利经济得以发展，结构转型伴随着独特的基础设施和治理结果。尽管已有大量研究考察了印度经济特区的宏观层面经济贡献，但除了最初关于土地剥夺的抗议之外，很少关注对当地地区的影响，也没有研究关注那些农村居民点被新工业区包围的人群所受到的影响。因此，印度新型城中村是否经历了与中国同类村庄相似的结构转型尚不得而知。

articles.title_en: Small-scale gold miners’ preferences on formalization: First steps toward sustainable supply chains in Colombia
articles.title_cn: 小规模金矿矿工对正规化的偏好：迈向哥伦比亚可持续供应链的第一步
articles.abstract_en: Artisanal and small-scale gold mining employs millions of poor people, globally–yet also significantly degrades the environment. Support from conscientious buyers, based on the information within supply-chain certifications, could induce lower environmental impacts and raise incomes, leading miners to be willing to incur costs to participate in sustainable supply chains. As certification may require formalization, we explore miners’ motivations for and barriers to formalization within a choice experiment in two Community Councils in Afro-descendent areas of Colombia’s Pacific Region: Yurumangui, in Valle del Cauca; and San Juan, in Choco. Community Councils have collective land rights—which might make them more willing to engage in collective actions often required for formalization. We find that while all miners prefer to leave their status quo towards formalization, the Councils differed in miners’ views of formalization. Given the options we offered, San Juan expressed less interest overall, perhaps due to negative past experience with formalization. Yurumangui was more willing to form or join an association and to formalize, likely due to positive past organization outcomes. Prior voluntary restoration effort correlated with individual miner willingness to restore sites. Additionally, we found no consistent significant effect of gender. Our results inform interventions supporting formalization in small-scale gold mining communities: miners are willing to try formalization yet perceive specific costs which hinder adoption in ways that vary with Councils’ legacies.
articles.abstract_cn: 手工和小规模金矿开采在全球雇用了数百万贫困人口，同时也严重破坏环境。基于供应链认证信息的良心买家支持，可以降低环境影响并提高收入，从而使矿工愿意承担参与可持续供应链的成本。由于认证可能要求正规化，我们在哥伦比亚太平洋地区两个非裔社区委员会中进行了一项选择实验，探讨矿工对正规化的动机和障碍：位于考卡山谷省的尤鲁曼吉和乔科省的圣胡安。社区委员会拥有集体土地权利——这可能使他们更愿意参与正规化通常所需的集体行动。我们发现，虽然所有矿工都倾向于改变现状走向正规化，但两个委员会在矿工对正规化的看法上存在差异。在我们提供的选项中，圣胡安总体上兴趣较低，可能是由于过去正规化的负面经历。尤鲁曼吉更愿意组建或加入协会并实现正规化，可能是因为过去组织成果积极。先前的自愿恢复努力与矿工个人恢复场地的意愿相关。此外，我们没有发现性别的一致显著影响。我们的研究结果为支持小规模金矿社区正规化的干预措施提供了信息：矿工愿意尝试正规化，但感知到特定成本，这些成本以因委员会历史遗产而异的方式阻碍了采纳。

articles.title_en: Contestation, conflict and claims-making around the Lake Turkana Wind Power windfarm, northern Kenya
articles.title_cn: 肯尼亚北部图尔卡纳湖风电场周围的争夺、冲突与权利要求
articles.abstract_en: Investment in large-scale renewable-energy projects has risen significantly as governments focus on green energy solutions. The general view is that renewable energy investments are beneficial, increasing national energy production from renewable sources and contributing to economic growth. However, the benefits for communities near project sites can be unclear, with less emphasis placed on the impacts on social cohesion or the rights of local populations. This paper contributes to discussions about community perspectives and responses to large land and resource based investments, stressing the role of local agency. Using the example of the Lake Turkana Wind Power (LTWP) project in northern Kenya, it examines how various stakeholders involved with specific resource-based investments perceive and challenge the development process and the distribution of project benefits and harms. It employs an ‘intersecting methodologies’ approach that includes community-based participatory research (CBPR), participatory video, and qualitative and ethnographic methods, conducted in small settlements around the LTWP area between 2017 and 2019. As the largest single private investment in Kenya’s history, life remains insecure for many residents near the LTWP wind farm. By revealing different local perspectives, the paper outlines the broader impacts and forms of contentious politics related to the LTWP project. The study finds that community strategies to seek recognition and associated rights highlight deeper conflicts involving governance and authority concerning everyday lives and livelihoods. Local agency underscores the limitations of efforts to formalize rights within a statutory legal and regulatory framework and other processes through which community stakeholders assert their inclusion in large-scale investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着各国政府聚焦于绿色能源解决方案，大规模可再生能源项目的投资显著增加。普遍观点认为，可再生能源投资是有益的，能够增加国家来自可再生能源的电力生产并促进经济增长。然而，对于项目附近社区而言，其益处可能并不明确，且较少关注对社会凝聚力或当地居民权利的影响。本文旨在促进关于社区对大型土地和资源投资的观点与回应的讨论，强调地方能动性的作用。以肯尼亚北部的图尔卡纳湖风电项目为例，本文考察了与特定资源型投资相关的各利益相关方如何感知和挑战发展过程以及项目利益与损害的分配。本文采用“交叉方法论”方法，包括基于社区的参与式研究、参与式视频以及定性和民族志方法，于2017至2019年间在图尔卡纳湖风电项目周边的小型定居点开展。作为肯尼亚历史上最大的单一私人投资，图尔卡纳湖风电场附近许多居民的生活仍不安全。通过揭示不同的地方视角，本文概述了与图尔卡纳湖风电项目相关的更广泛影响和争议性政治形式。研究发现，社区寻求承认及相关权利的战略凸显了涉及日常生活和生计的治理与权威方面的更深层次冲突。地方能动性强调了在法定法律和监管框架内正式化权利的努力以及社区利益相关者主张其纳入大规模投资的其他过程的局限性。

articles.title_en: Robot and crime: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 机器人犯罪：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence on the effects of industrial robots on crime. We exploit the variation in the initial distribution of industrial employment across Chinese cities and the difference in robot adoption across industries over time to identify the impact of robot exposure on crime rates. We find that cities with higher exposure to industrial robots have lower overall crime rates. We also provide evidence that industrial robot exposure increases employment opportunities for low-educated adults, who are more likely to engage in criminal activities. These findings contribute to a growing body of research on the socio-economic implications of automation and offer valuable insights for policymakers aiming to address crime and promote economic development through technological advancements.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次提供了工业机器人对犯罪影响的证据。我们利用中国各城市初始工业就业分布的差异以及不同行业随时间机器人采用的不同，来识别机器人暴露对犯罪率的影响。我们发现，工业机器人暴露程度较高的城市，其总体犯罪率较低。我们还提供证据表明，工业机器人暴露增加了低教育水平成年人的就业机会，而这一群体更可能参与犯罪活动。这些发现为关于自动化社会经济影响的研究日益增多做出了贡献，并为旨在通过技术进步解决犯罪和促进经济发展的政策制定者提供了宝贵的见解。
